name: Community Action Partnership of North Dakota: veteran housing help (SSVF)
organization: Community Action Partnership of North Dakota
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 12-ND-051): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Adams County, Barnes County, Benson County, Billings County, Bottineau County, Bowman County, Burke County, Burleigh County, Cass County, Cavalier County, Dickey County, Divide County and 41 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
